name: FastH3 Omni
description: FastH3 Omni, an 8-step MiniMax H3 ref2va video model (reference-to-video with audio)
notes: 8-step distilled MiniMax H3 [ref2va]: 24 fps video with synchronized 32 kHz stereo audio. 8 steps (NOT the 50-step base H3), Text Guidance 1.0, DDIM Trailing, Shift 12, Audio Shift 3. Official recipe is 768-pixel short side (1280x768, verified on .150: 73 frames in 539s); this preset uses a lighter 832x512 that fits a 12GB card with headroom. Reference-to-video: reference images can be attached in the Video tab and referenced as <Picture 1>, <Picture 2>. 73 frames ~= 3s at 24 fps. Tiled decoding OFF: the tile values in the phone export describe local hardware, not the model.
